topic: Data transfer measurements and protocol changes
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on initial data measurements following a change in the data transfer protocol. One participant reported an initial measurement of 1.47Mb per hour, equating to approximately 1.08Gb per month. Another measurement was noted at around 1.5 Mb/h. The participants agreed that further analysis or confirmation should wait until the next morning.
decisions: Wait until tomorrow morning for final data review.
